trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so never chase it directly. Work the roadmap stages in order, use the per-grade counters in this tracker (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze) to spot what is left, and expect the two golds — the final mission and 100% completion — to be the long tail. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Play it on any difficulty and follow the on-screen prompts while the controls are introduced; the trophy pops at the mission end card. It is pure story progression, so it cannot be missed while you play the campaign. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (story order); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete every Chapter 1 mission in order; the trophy pops after the chapter's final mission resolves. Nothing optional feeds it, so just keep following the story markers — but clear the early Ocean Beach moment for In The Beginning… while you are still in this part of the game. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full. Keep a rotating manual save from this chapter onward: the choice-driven trophy Actions Speak Louder builds up during story missions, and a save from before a choice-heavy mission is your insurance. The chapter trophy itself is automatic story progression. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 in full. By now the map and activity types are opening up, so start sampling one of each activity as they appear — that groundwork is what Master of None later counts. The chapter trophy pops automatically at the chapter's end. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase — GTA VI trophies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 in full. Treat the end of this chapter as a soft point of no return: before pushing into the finale, sweep up the story-beat missables flagged in this tracker (Catch Me If You Can at VCIA, Capital Offense in the showroom) if you have not triggered them yet. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission — one of only two golds. Make a manual save before starting it, finish any remaining story-beat missables first, and bring your best weapons and armour into the ending sequence. The trophy pops once the final mission resolves. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (ending); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the map. Named-mission trophies like this one pop on the mission completion screen regardless of your score or take, so a clean finish is all that is required. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Do the setup steps the mission gives you, pick the approach you are most comfortable with, and finish the escape — the trophy is for completing the heist, not for a maximum take or a no-deaths run. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play. It pops on completion whatever route you take through the mission, so play it naturally and save stunt, combat and exploration feats for free roam. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; Exophase — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. As with the other named-mission trophies, finishing the mission is the whole requirement — no medal, time or accuracy condition is attached. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission set at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). While the story has you at the airport, also watch for Catch Me If You Can — the unscheduled-departure feat tied to VCIA — because that one does not come back around. This mission trophy itself pops on completion. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. Stock up on armour and snacks before starting it — it is a combat-heavy set piece — and the trophy pops on the completion screen. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the second gold and usually the last trophy before the platinum. Story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed the percentage, so work this tracker's stages in order and then use the in-game 100% checklist to name exactly which category is still short instead of grinding blind. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI 100% completion guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts (PlayStation tracks the count to 250). Stunt spots are spread across Leonida, so fold them into the Stage 3 exploration sweep: hit each marked stunt once with a fast car or bike, and retry a failed attempt on the spot — only completed stunts add to the counter. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI stunt locations guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 250).
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI collectibles & stunts guides (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the game offers 9 activity types. You only need to start one of each, not win or finish it, so sample a new type whenever its icon first appears during the story and this pops quietly in the background. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PlayStation tracks 42). Learn one range's target pattern at a time and replay a challenge immediately while it is fresh; if a weapon class keeps costing you gold, come back after story progress with better weapons and stats. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Shooting Range guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 42).
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in total. A win is needed, not just a finish, so learn each short course with one practice run, then push for first place; tick locations off in this tracker as you clear them so none is left hiding at 13 of 14. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the key word: repeating one easy race 20 times does not count. Enter each new race event as it unlocks, bring a vehicle suited to its class, and use this tracker to note which events you have already won. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 20); PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Accept Cal's challenge when you meet him at the fishing spots, use the best bait and rod you have unlocked, and play the challenge's own scoring — biggest or most fish before time runs out — rather than free fishing. Losing costs nothing; challenge him again straight away. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to its completion screen at any arcade cabinet. Pick the shortest cabinet game you find, finish it in one sitting, and the trophy pops — you do not need a high score or every cabinet. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Work each Andy mission as its icon appears — strands unlock in sequence, so the final mission only shows after the earlier ones are done — and this strand also counts toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger strands); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Follow Kenton's missions in order as they appear; the trophy pops when his last mission ends, and the finished strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Clear Billy's earlier missions first — the finale only unlocks at the end of his chain — and count the finished strand toward the 8 needed for Strangers & Freaks. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida (PlayStation tracks 8). A strand means the stranger's whole chain, not just the introductory meeting: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each give you one, and the remaining strands come from the other strangers scattered over the state — finish strands fully instead of starting many and abandoning them. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI stranger strands guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 8).
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Play Randy's chain in order as the missions appear and the trophy pops at the end of his finale; the completed strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. As with the other named strangers, his finale only appears after his earlier missions are cleared, and finishing it adds one more strand to Strangers & Freaks. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. Treat the spots like a collectible set: sweep them region by region during the Stage 3 exploration pass, complete the meditation prompt at each one, and tick regions off here so the last missing spot is easy to hunt. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI collectibles guide (meditation spots); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Hunt the unique animal for Bret. This is a one-animal hunt inside Bret's strand: make a manual save before the final approach, follow the trail quietly, and take the animal cleanly when it appears. Because the animal is unique, losing it can close the strand without the trophy — that is why this guide flags it missable and puts it early, in Stage 2. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Bret strand); PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden pickups all over Leonida; rather than collecting at random, use the in-game set view to target the sets you are closest to finishing and sweep those locations first — three completed sets, not a total card count, is what pops the trophy. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI collectible cards guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations (PlayStation tracks 100). Make it a habit during exploration: whenever you arrive somewhere new — a shop, a landmark, a new neighbourhood — WAiNK It once before moving on, and the counter climbs without a dedicated grind until late in Stage 3. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 100); PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges (PlayStation tracks 50). Challenges are the short world tasks the game surfaces as you play; accept them when they appear instead of driving past, favour the quick categories first, and check the challenge counter in game before starting a dedicated cleanup session. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase — GTA VI trophies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose it and fully escape the heat together. Pick open ground near cover and a fast car: build the four stars, break line of sight, and keep moving until the stars clear — both partners must come through the escape. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Scout a cluster of three nearby shops first, park outside the first, and move straight to the next after each robbery — if the stars drop to zero before the third till, the chain resets. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles (PlayStation tracks 100). A vehicle counts when you get in and drive it, so swap cars constantly: steal parked models you have not driven, vary your story vehicles, and visit rich neighbourhoods and the airport for rarer models. Registering finds in the Scooter Bros app at the same time also feeds On the Spot. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 100); PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Do not trigger it on the first enemy you see: let a group cluster — dense story firefights and gang operations are ideal — then activate Combat Focus once and work through five targets before it ends. A failed attempt costs nothing; reposition and try the next group. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). This hangs on the story's airport beat: when the game takes you through VCIA, leave by your own unscheduled departure — take off or drive out on your own terms instead of following the scripted exit. Once that story beat is over the moment does not repeat, so this guide flags it missable and places it in Stage 1, alongside Hi-Jacked. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (VCIA missions); PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a pun: a Rhino is the in-game tank, and 'hot' is the heat it draws. Push a Wanted Level high enough for military hardware to deploy — or find a Rhino at a military site — then take one over and stay in it while the heat is on until the trophy registers. Armour up first; getting in is the dangerous part. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; Exophase — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quietly with a suppressed approach, keep the detection meter empty, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a loud entry or a spotted getaway voids the attempt, but the store can be tried again another day. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)
PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape after each one (PlayStation tracks 5). A vault robbery only counts when you get away, so plan the exit before you go in: vehicle staged, route away from the bank, and a place to break line of sight. Five different successful escapes, not five attempts. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 5); PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Watch for a roaming armored truck in free roam, block it in, breach the rear doors, grab the cash and lose the Wanted Level that follows — the escape is part of the requirement, so have a fast car ready before you open the doors. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the state is divided into 52 areas, and each one must be uncovered. Systematically drive or fly the grey parts of the map region by region during Stage 3; remote corners and islands are the areas most players are still missing at the end. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI exploration & collectibles guides; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — there are 9 gangs, and one operation per gang is enough. Variety is the trap: robbing the same gang's operations repeatedly does not advance it, so note which gang each operation belongs to and target the gangs still missing from your list. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Do this during your first Ocean Beach window early in the story: order a cocktail at a beachfront spot overlooking the ocean and drink it there. It is tied to that early moment rather than to free-roam shopping, so this guide flags it missable — grab it in Chapter 1 instead of assuming the same moment comes back. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: when the story puts you inside a vehicle showroom, get into a showroom car and drive it straight out through the glass frontage. It depends on that one set piece — walk out the door and the moment is gone — so this guide flags it missable and keeps it in Stage 1. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley, start a game of bowling there and complete the follow-through the description asks for — a full visit and game at that specific alley, not bowling anywhere else. It doubles as one of the activity types sampled for Master of None. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — PlayStation hides this one behind a deliberately vague line: a partnership moment with mass appeal. It hangs on a story choice with your partner in front of an audience: when the story offers the partnership spotlight, take the public, crowd-pleasing option rather than the quiet exit. Because the choice is locked once the mission ends, this guide flags it missable — keep a manual save before partner set pieces. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (hidden trophy); PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: MISSABLE-leaning — Choices made, for better or worse: PlayStation tracks a count that runs to 500. Actively choose whenever the game offers a dialogue or approach choice instead of letting scenes play out untouched, and the counter builds across the story. Individual choices lock when a mission ends, which is why this guide flags it: keep a rotating manual save before choice-heavy missions. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 500); PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: MISSABLE-leaning — Second time's the charm: this rewards succeeding on a second attempt after a first one goes wrong. The clean route is a repeatable checkpoint: let an attempt fail, then clear it on the immediate retry. A flawless first-time run through every story attempt leaves few natural chances, so this guide flags it — a checkpoint reload is the deliberate way to set the second try up. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the game's strange event — the description ('What the hell just happened?') is the joke: this is the weird-encounter trophy. Explore remote parts of Leonida at night during the Stage 3/4 sweeps and investigate anything out of place; the trophy pops when the scripted strange moment plays out in front of you. Sources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, use your melee attack as you pass a target and bowl them over — the bowling joke in the name is about the victim, not the alley. A slow pass in a crowded area gives you the timing; it may take a few passes to land cleanly. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide.
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of Marked Bills through your contacts (PlayStation tracks the dollar total). Marked Bills come from robberies, so route your Stage 4 robbery income through the laundering contacts instead of spending it raw, and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough — check the running figure before planning an endgame grind. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total (PlayStation tracks the dollar total). It is cumulative across every shop, so normal play — vehicles, weapons, clothes, property upkeep — does most of it; if you are short late in the game, Stage 5 purchases such as garage properties close the gap quickly. Sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list; Exophase — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages appear as property purchases on the map; buy each one as your funds allow and save the most expensive for Stage 5, when robbery and laundering income is flowing. Owning every garage — not visiting them — is the requirement. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI property guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap (powerpyx.com)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you get into a vehicle you intend to keep — especially while discovering new models for Whip It Good — register it in the app there and then; ten registrations build up naturally during the Stage 3 vehicle sweep. Sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide; PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (tracked count 10).
sources: PlayStationTrophies.org — GTA VI trophy list & guide (playstationtrophies.org)
